_: Written by brand/build.py. The mark's outline in its own units, for the cloth shader's woven figure.

palette_notes.indigo: Indigo — the logo's navy taken to the depth of indigo-dyed cloth; the house ground
palette_notes.ink: Ink — the deepest shade, for the cloth's shadows and the footer
palette_notes.chalk: Chalk — the tailor's chalk; the light ground and the text on indigo
palette_notes.greige: Greige — undyed cloth, the logo's grey warmed; rules and quiet text on indigo
palette_notes.selvedge: Selvedge red — the logo's red, kept as one thread: the mill's ID line on a selvedge edge
